
## Test fonts

`KasaneTest.ttf` — generated by `make_font.py` (fontTools,
Apache-2.0) from scratch; no external font data is copied. All glyphs
are simple rectangular outlines so pixel checks are trivially
verifiable. Regenerate with `/tmp/pdfcmp/bin/python /tmp/m5/make_font.py`
(the script lives outside the repo since fontTools is a build-time
tool, not a runtime dependency).

WinAnsiEncoding tables in `src/font.rs` are derived from ISO 32000-1
Annex D and the Adobe Glyph List (public-domain name→Unicode mapping
shipped by fontTools).
